content: gxhash stable 3.5.0 (2025-03-11), git master 4.0.0 unreleased. README at both 3.5.0 tag and master: requires x86 AES-NI+SSE2 or ARM AES+NEON enabled at compile time; quote: Other platforms are currently not supported (there is no fallback). GxHash will not build on these platforms. Needs target-cpu=native or +aes target features, breaking portable x86_64 CI and wheel builds. No MSRV declared. DISQUALIFIED for rustkmer dual-surface distribution.
